scope: Supplementary post-hoc replay of the common set of 32 native full-frame development-monitor centers (8 existing development sequences x 4 frames). Each model/checkpoint uses a newly optimized descriptive threshold on these 32 centers with <=1 FP/center. No new data or independent replications.

method.center_manifest: Frame IDs and XY centroids in the officially bound 6000-step monitoring archive. All selected centers contain exactly one annotated object.
method.postprocessing: Archived raw peak_yx and peak_scores already include the official native-image 8-connected regional-maximum plateau representative and Chebyshev radius 2 NMS. Recomputed FP64 squared distance from peak coordinates to stored native mask centroid.
method.curve: Used the official _curve and _at_budget function bodies without modification. Threshold includes tied scores. Peak within squared distance <=9 matches exactly one GT; other kept peaks count toward FP.
method.selection: Among attainable global thresholds with FP<=32 on 32 frames, maximize TP then minimize FP then choose highest threshold. Official 672-panel thresholds only used as independent validation, not as subset thresholds.
